scope: Dual-observer stabilization of the 27.5-second JoyAI flower-arranging robot layer
summary: The v30 composition passes both frozen temporal observers and preserves contact/grasp safety, but it remains PARTIAL because the clean-runtime long-video audit passes 13/14 image gates rather than all gates.
evidence: Across 161 risk transitions, source-motion mean falls 7.269%, p95 falls 12.927%, maximum falls 26.6538 to 23.6002, and count-above-20 falls 7 to 4.
The independent candidate-self observer reduces mean 4.611%, p95 9.655%, maximum 11.6883 to 11.0219, and count above the frozen 5.875135 threshold from 8 to 7.

The native-resolution v34 audit retains late projected contact 11/11, persistent visual grasp 147/147, erasure-attack rejection 147/147, and detects color, topology, contact-removal, and structure-ghost attacks.
The unchanged spatial-chroma-TV gate fails at 9.746221 against a 5.981568 limit; the threshold was not relaxed.
The incremental bidirectional plus causal passes take 116.1404 seconds for 660 frames, or 5.6828 FPS.
lessons: Past/future candidate correspondence and source-motion causal state encode complementary temporal evidence; strict agreement across both reduces score gaming.
Visual promotion must remain separate from image-space contact, physical contact, and generalization claims.
limitations: The candidate fails one frozen appearance gate and is validated on only one scene.
Projected overlap and occlusion bridging do not establish 3-D depth, contact force, force closure, or executable robot motion.
next_actions: Replace the coarse person-envelope chroma diagnostic with an additional replacement-grounded diagnostic without deleting or relaxing the frozen legacy gate.
Replicate both temporal observers on independent flower-arranging scenes.
